events.quote: The order directs the Purchasers and Aixtron to take all steps necessary to fully and permanently abandon the proposed acquisition of Aixtron’s U.S. business not later than 30 days
The President took this action pursuant to section 721 of the Defense Production Act of 1950, as amended by the Foreign Investment and National Security Act of 2007 (Section 721).
The President’s decision took into consideration the factors described in subsection 721(f), as appropriate, and the recommendation by CFIUS
The President’s decision is specific to this transaction and is not a determination with regard to any other foreign direct investment from China or any other country.
